blocks.text: BRISBANE — Major fossil fuel-producing nations including Australia must stop expanding coal and gas developments to prevent climate change devastating Pacific nations and forcing people to leave their homes. Tuvalu Climate Change Minister Maina Vakafua Talia issued the call at The Australia Institute’s Climate Integrity Summit in Sydney on Tuesday, while warning low-lying nations would need financial help to establish large-scale renewable energy solutions. ‘The warning comes after a United Nations report found island nations faced the risk of submersion when temperatures rose by more than 1.5C, and weeks before Tuvalu is due to host world leaders at a pre-COP event.
